verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's marketing pages mention PyTorch by name as one of several 'inference backends' optimized for RTX AI PCs, and the CUDA Toolkit page confirms a general GPU-accelerated development environment (compiler, libraries, Nsight tools) that underlies frameworks like PyTorch. However, there is no dedicated support matrix, versioned CUDA/cuDNN compatibility table, or official PyTorch installation guide tied specifically to RTX 5080/Blackwell in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit PyTorch-CUDA compatibility/support matrix, official install docs referencing RTX 5080 architecture, independent confirmation of working PyTorch builds on this GPU.
